description: Start a schema check of one proposed subgraph schema against a variant, the same check that `rover subgraph check` starts. The check runs in the background, so this returns a workflow ID and a Studio URL, not a result. Pass the returned workflowID to GetCheckResults to read the outcome. Provide the graph ID, the variant name, the subgraph name, and the proposed subgraph schema as SDL. Optionally provide the git branch and commit to label the run in Studio.

GraphQLDocument.description: A GraphQL document, such as a schema in SDL syntax.

name: RunSubgraphCheck
